mentions.name: Metric Me
mentions.description: Metric Me is a dashboard for your body that centralizes personal health data — blood test results, weight, and blood pressure readings — replacing years of records previously kept in a text file on the desktop.
mentions.problem: The author tracked blood test results, weight, and blood pressure for nearly 20 years while managing high blood pressure and low platelets, but the data lived in a plain text file on their desktop; they wanted something more substantial to keep it in check.
